style: Comprehensive meaningful blend (interpretive text) + amplified study form; bare transliterations in amp with Strong's carried in notes; em-dashes used sparingly; transliterations ASCII-normalized relative to the lexicon's spellings; 'the LORD' for YHWH; deity pronouns capitalized.
chapterNote: The king's own household charter, sung to God as a vow. It begins where every honest resolution has to begin -- I will sing of covenant love and justice, to You, O LORD -- because the two things he is about to promise are the two things God is. Then the resolve: I will act with careful wisdom in the blameless way, and inside my own house I will walk with a whole heart. What follows is a list of what will not be tolerated in the palace, and it is a list of people rather than policies: nothing worthless set before his eyes, no crooked heart kept near, no secret slanderer of a neighbor, no man with lofty eyes and a heart grown wide with appetite. And a list of who gets in: his eyes are on the faithful of the land, and the man who walks the blameless way is the one who serves him. In the middle of the vow sits one line that does not belong to a man at all -- when will You come to me? -- the admission that a clean house needs a Guest before it needs a code. Readers from Augustine onward have noticed that the last verse, morning by morning cutting off the wicked from the city of the LORD, is more than David ever managed, and that only one Son of David keeps this charter.

1.text: A psalm of David. I will sing of covenant love and justice; to You, O LORD, I will make music.
1.amp: A Psalm [mizmor] of David. I will sing [shir] of mercy [chesed -- covenant love] and judgment [mishpat -- justice]: unto You, O LORD [YHWH], will I sing [zamar -- make music].
1.notes: chesed u-mishpat ashirah (H2617, H4941, H7891): of chesed and mishpat I will SING -- the pair Micah 6:8 holds together (do justly, love mercy), kin to the Name of Exodus 34:6-7, and the two things this psalm is about to promise in a household; lekha YHWH azammerah (H3068, H2167): to You, LORD, I will make music. The king does not announce his policy to his court; he sings it to God, which is what turns a manifesto into a vow.

2.text: I will act with careful wisdom in the blameless way -- when will You come to me? -- I will walk inside my house with a whole heart.
2.amp: I will behave myself wisely [sakal -- act with careful wisdom] in a perfect [tamim -- blameless] way [derek]. O when will You come [bo] unto me? I will walk [halak] within [qereb] my house [bayith] with a perfect [tom -- whole] heart [lebab].
2.notes: askilah be-derekh tamim (H7919, H1870, H8549): I will give WISE ATTENTION to the tamim way -- sakal, the insight-verb of Psalm 41:1; matai tabo elai (H935): when will You COME to me? -- the one line in the charter that is not a resolution but a longing, sitting oddly in the middle of the promises, and honest for that reason: a clean house needs a Guest before it needs a code. ethallekh be-tom-lebabi be-qereb beti (H8537, H3824, H7130, H1004): I will walk in the wholeness of my heart INSIDE my house -- where nobody is watching.

3.text: I will set nothing worthless before my eyes; I hate the work of those who turn aside -- it will not cling to me.
3.amp: I will set [shith] no wicked ['thing of Belial', beliyyaal, the KJV margin] thing [dabar] before mine eyes [ayin]: I hate [sane] the work [asah] of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave [dabaq] to me.
3.notes: lo-ashit le-neged enai debar-beliyyaal (H7896, H5869, H1697, H1100): I will not set before my eyes a 'thing of Belial', the margin's literal -- worthlessness given a place in the field of vision, which is where most compromise starts (cf. Job 31:1); asoh-setim saneti (H6213, H7750, H8130): the doing of those who SWERVE I have hated; lo yidbaq bi (H1692): it will not CLING to me -- dabaq, the cleaving-word of Genesis 2:24: he refuses to be married to it.

4.text: A crooked heart will keep away from me; I will not acknowledge what is evil.
4.amp: A froward heart [lebab] shall depart [sur] from me: I will not know [yada] a wicked [ra] person.
4.notes: lebab iqqesh yasur mimmenni (H3824, H6141, H5493): a TWISTED heart -- iqqesh, bent out of true, the word for the crooked generation of Deuteronomy 32:5 -- will turn aside from me; ra lo eda (H7451, H3045): evil I will not KNOW -- yada, which in a royal context means acknowledge, recognize, admit to the circle. Not ignorance of evil; refusal to grant it standing.

5.text: Whoever secretly slanders his neighbor, him I will silence; the man with lofty eyes and a heart grown wide with appetite I will not endure.
5.amp: Whoso privily [sether] slanders his neighbour [rea], him will I cut off: him that has an high [gebah] look [ayin] and a proud [rachab -- wide] heart [lebab] will not I suffer [yakol -- endure].
5.notes: melashni ba-seter reehu oto atsmit (H3960, H5643, H7453, H6789): the one who tongues his neighbor in SECRET -- the informer of Psalm 52, Doeg's trade -- him I will silence. gebah-enayim u-rechab lebab oto lo ukhal (H1362, H5869, H7342, H3824, H3201): lofty of eyes and WIDE of heart -- rachab, broad, the appetite that has room for anything -- him I cannot endure. Proverbs 6:16-19's list of what the LORD hates, adopted as a hiring policy.

6.text: My eyes are on the faithful of the land, so that they may live with me; the one who walks the blameless way -- he is the one who serves me.
6.amp: Mine eyes [ayin] shall be upon the faithful [aman] of the land [eretz], that they may dwell [yashab] with me: he that walks [halak] in a perfect ['perfect in the way', tamim, the KJV margin] way [derek], he shall serve [sharath] me.
6.notes: enai be-neemne-erets la-shebet immadi (H5869, H539, H776, H3427): my eyes are on the FAITHFUL of the land, to sit with me -- the same eyes that refused the worthless thing in verse 3, now scanning for the trustworthy. holekh be-derekh tamim hu yesharteni (H1980, H1870, H8549, H8334): the one walking the blameless way, HE will minister to me -- sharath, the word for priests serving in the sanctuary, used of palace staff. Character as the only qualification listed.

7.text: No one who practices deceit will live inside my house; no one who tells lies will stand before my eyes.
7.amp: He that works [asah] deceit [remiyah] shall not dwell [yashab] within [qereb] my house [bayith]: he that tells [dabar] lies [sheqer] shall not tarry ['shall not be established', kun, the KJV margin] in my sight [ayin].
7.notes: lo-yesheb be-qereb beti oseh remiyah (H3427, H7130, H1004, H6213, H7423): no worker of remiyah -- treachery, Psalm 52:2's word for Doeg's razor -- will dwell INSIDE my house; dober sheqarim lo-yikkon le-neged enai (H1696, H8267, H3559, H5869): the speaker of lies will not be ESTABLISHED -- the margin's literal -- before my eyes. Ananias and Sapphira (Acts 5) is this verse enforced in the house of God.

8.text: Morning by morning I will put an end to all the wicked of the land, cutting off every worker of iniquity from the city of the LORD.
8.amp: I will early [boqer -- morning by morning] destroy all the wicked [rasha] of the land [eretz]; that I may cut off [karath] all wicked [aven] doers [paal] from the city [ir] of the LORD [YHWH].
8.notes: la-beqarim atsmit kol-rishe-arets (H1242, H6789, H7563, H776): 'at the mornings' -- morning by morning, the hour when men with a cause came to the king for judgment at the gate (2 Samuel 15:2, where Absalom rose early to intercept them) -- I will put an end to all the wicked of the land; le-hakhrit me-ir-YHWH kol-poale aven (H3772, H5892, H3068, H6466, H205): to cut off from the CITY OF THE LORD all workers of wickedness. The vow ends larger than any king could keep it -- David's own house produced Amnon and Absalom -- which is why the church has long read the charter as belonging finally to the Son of David, who does purge His city (cf. Matthew 13:41; Revelation 21:27).
